services_list.title: Web & App Development
services_list.description: High-performance websites and web applications built with Next.js and React.
services_list.long_description: I build modern web applications that are not just visually stunning but also engineered for performance and scalability. Using the latest technologies like Next.js 14, React, and TailwindCSS, I create digital experiences that load instantly, rank high on Google, and convert visitors into customers. Whether you need a simple landing page or a complex SaaS platform, I deliver code that is clean, maintainable, and future-proof.

services_list.title: Mobile App Development
services_list.description: Native-quality mobile apps built with React Native.
services_list.long_description: Get two apps for the price of one. Using React Native, I build cross-platform mobile applications that work flawlessly on both iOS and Android. These aren't just 'web views' - they are true native apps with access to camera, location, push notifications, and high-performance animations. I handle everything from the initial logic to the submission process on the App Store and Play Store.
